2. Reason: The WebSurfer agent in Step 4 proposes to "open" the video to determine the racetrack. However, as a web search tool, it cannot directly play or watch YouTube videos to analyze the visual content at a specific timestamp (the two-minute mark). It can only retrieve metadata, titles, descriptions, or comments. To identify the track being played, the agent needs to search for a description of the video's content, a transcript, or a summary of the gameplay at that specific time, rather than attempting to "open" and watch the video itself. This approach is technically impossible for a text-based search tool and will fail to gather the necessary information.
